qe: Which animal phylum is made of cells arranged at the 'cellular level of organisation', where cells do not form true tissues?
qh: किस जंतु संघ में कोशिकाएँ 'कोशिकीय स्तर' (cellular level) पर व्यवस्थित रहती हैं और वास्तविक ऊतक (tissue) नहीं बनातीं?
e: Concept: Jeevon ke sharir me organisation ke levels hote hain - cellular level (sirf cells, tissue nahi), tissue level, organ level aur organ-system level. Sponges (Porifera) me cells alag-alag kaam karte hain par unse sachche tissue nahi bante - isliye unhe cellular level kehte hain (jaise 'choanocytes' cells jo paani ka bahav chalate hain). Baaki teen aage ke levels wale hain: Coelenterata me tissue level (do parat), Platyhelminthes me organ level aur Annelida me organ-system level. Exam point: 'Cellular level = Porifera (sponges)'.

qe: The skeleton (supporting framework) of sponges is made up of tiny needle-like structures called:
qh: स्पंज (sponge) का कंकाल छोटी सुई जैसी संरचनाओं से बना होता है, जिन्हें कहते हैं:
e: Concept: Sponge ke naram sharir ko sahara dene ke liye do cheezein hoti hain - chhote kankad/needle jaise kathor tukde (spicules, jo calcium carbonate ya silica ke bante hain) aur ek lachakdar protein ke reshe (spongin fibres). Inke aakar se hi sponge ki kismein pehchani jaati hain. Baaki teen alag cheezein hain: Nematocysts (cnidarians ke sting cells), Setae (annelid ke sharir par chhote baal), Nephridia (annelid ka excretory organ). Exam point: 'Sponge ka skeleton = spicules + spongin fibres'.

qe: Stinging cells called nematocysts (cnidoblasts) are the characteristic feature of which phylum?
qh: नेमेटोसिस्ट (डंक मारने वाली कोशिकाएँ) किस संघ की विशेषता हैं?
e: Concept: Coelenterata (Cnidaria) ke tentacles par khaas cells - nematocysts (cnidoblasts) - hote hain; inke andar ek khaas capsule aur usme juda hua 'thread' hota hai; jab koi jeev tentacle ko chhoota hai to ye thread bijli ki tarah chhut kar zeher ya chipku padarth daal deta hai - isliye jellyfish ka sparsh dard bhara hota hai. Ye 'stinging cells' hi is phylum ki pehchaan hain. Baaki teen phylum me aise sting cells nahi hote (Porifera, Mollusca, Annelida ke apne alag organs hain). Exam point: 'Nematocysts (stinging cells) = Coelenterata/Cnidaria'.

qe: Jellyfish, coral and sea anemone belong to which phylum?
qh: जेलीफिश, मूंगा (coral) और समुद्री एनीमोन किस संघ के हैं?
e: Concept: Coelenterata (Cnidaria) samudri janwar hain jinka sharir do paraton (bahari ectoderm aur andar endoderm) se banta hai, beech me ek jelly jaisi parat (mesoglea) hoti hai, aur munh ke charo taraf tentacles (sprish-kankal) hote hain; isi group me Jellyfish (Aurelia), Coral (moonga - jo samudri teela banata hai) aur Sea anemone (Adamsia) aate hain. Baaki teen alag phylum hain: Echinodermata (tara machhli), Mollusca (ghongha), Porifera (sponge). Exam point: 'Jellyfish, coral, sea anemone = Coelenterata (Cnidaria)'.

qe: Alternation of generation (metagenesis) between the polyp and medusa forms is best exhibited by:
qh: पॉलिप और मेडुसा रूपों के बीच पीढ़ी-एकांतरण (metagenesis) किसमें सबसे अच्छी तरह दिखता है?
e: Concept: Metagenesis (alternation of generation) matlab ek hi jeev ki zindagi me do roop bari-bari aate hain - ek nachne wale chhate jaisa 'polyp' (chipka hua, asexual) aur ek chhata/ghanti jaisa 'medusa' (tairne wala, sexual). Ye khaas karta Coelenterata ke kai sadasya karte hain jaise Obelia; isliye kehte hain ki uski ek peedhi polyp se aur doosri medusa se banti hai. Baaki teen me aisa do-roop cycle nahi hota: Earthworm (annelid), Ascaris (roundworm), Prawn (arthropod). Exam point: 'Metagenesis = polyp aur medusa ka ekantaran (jaise Obelia me)'.

qe: Flat, ribbon-like animals that have no body cavity (acoelomate) belong to which phylum?
qh: चपटे, फीता जैसे और शरीर-गुहा रहित (acoelomate) जंतु किस संघ के हैं?
e: Concept: Body cavity (coelom) ek andar ki khaali jagah hai jisme aant jaise ang latakte hain. Platyhelminthes (flatworms) me ye guha bilkul nahi hoti (acoelomate), isliye unka sharir chapta aur patla hota hai - kyunki unke andar ki jagah bharan ke liye koi gap nahi. Baaki teen me cavity hoti hai: Aschelminthes me 'pseudocoelom' (jhooti guha), Annelida se aage 'true coelom' (sachchi guha). Exam point: 'Acoelomate (guha bina) = Platyhelminthes (flatworms)'.

qe: Which of the following is a flatworm (Platyhelminthes)?
qh: इनमें से कौन चपटा कृमि (Platyhelminthes) है?
e: Concept: Flatworm ka body chapta, patla aur dono taraf se dabaa hua hota hai - jaise Tapeworm (fita kirmi, jo insaan ki aant me reh kar khana chusta hai) aur Liver fluke (jigar ka kirmi), Planaria (saf paani me rehne wala). Baaki teen alag groups ke hain: Roundworm (Ascaris - Nematoda/Aschelminthes), Earthworm (Annelida), Hookworm (Ancylostoma - Nematoda). Exam point: 'Flatworm = Platyhelminthes (tapeworm, liver fluke, planaria); roundworm = Nematoda'.

qe: The remarkable ability to regenerate a complete body from a small cut piece is classically seen in:
qh: कटे हुए छोटे टुकड़े से पूरा शरीर दोबारा बना लेने की क्षमता क्लासिक रूप से किसमें देखी जाती है?
e: Concept: Regeneration matlab sharir ka kata hua hissa dobara ugana. Planaria (ek flatworm jo saf paani me rehta hai) iska sabse mashhoor udaharan hai - uske sharir ke kisi bhi chhote tukde se poora naya jeev ban sakta hai kyunki uske andar khaas 'stem jaisi' cells (neoblasts) hoti hain jo kisi bhi kism ki cell ban sakti hain. Baaki teen me ye shakti seemit ya bahut kam hoti hai: Ascaris (roundworm), Leech (annelid), Prawn (arthropod). Exam point: 'Regeneration ka classic udaharan = Planaria'.

qe: Roundworms such as Ascaris belong to which phylum?
qh: गोल कृमि जैसे एस्केरिस किस संघ के हैं?
e: Concept: Aschelminthes (Nematoda/roundworms) ka body gol aur lamba hota hai (dono sire pujh, dhaage jaisa), chapta nahi; unke paas ek 'pseudocoelom' hota hai (sachchi coelom nahi, ek jhooti guha) aur ek khaas feature - unka paachak nali munh se guda tak seedhi hoti hai. Inme Ascaris (insaan ki aant me), hookworm, pinworm aate hain. Baaki teen phylum se ye alag hai (Platyhelminthes chapta, Annelida me segments, Mollusca me shell/mantle). Exam point: 'Roundworms = Aschelminthes/Nematoda (pseudocoelom + gol sharir)'.

qe: Elephantiasis (filariasis), in which legs swell like an elephant's, is caused by which worm?
qh: हाथीपाँव (फाइलेरिया) रोग किस कृमि से होता है?
e: Concept: Filariasis (haathipaun) ek worm Wuchereria bancrofti se hota hai jo ek mosquito (Culex) ke kaatne se insaan me aata hai; ye kirmi lymph naliyon (body ki saf paani wali naliyan) me baith kar unhe band kar deti hai, isliye pair/haath me paani jamta hai aur bahut soojh aa jati hai. Baaki teen doosre rogon ke kirmi hain: Ascaris (aant ka roundworm), Taenia (tapeworm - pakkashay/unded), Fasciola (liver fluke - jigar). Exam point: 'Haathipaun/filariasis = Wuchereria bancrofti (Culex mosquito se)'.

qe: Hookworm infection, which is a common cause of anaemia in poor sanitation areas, is caused by:
qh: हुकवर्म संक्रमण, जो खराब सफाई वाले इलाकों में खून की कमी (एनीमिया) का आम कारण है, किससे होता है?
e: Concept: Hookworm (Ancylostoma duodenale) insaan ki chhoti aant me chipak kar khoon chusta hai; isse saalon tak khoon aur iron kam hone se anaemia (khoon ki kami, sufed pan, kamzori) ho jati hai. Ye larva nange pair se chamdi ke through shareer me ghusta hai - isliye safai aur shoes pehanna bachav hai. Baaki teen: Wuchereria (haathipaun), Ascaris (aant ka bada roundworm, anaemia nahi), Nereis (samudri annelid, insaan me nahi). Exam point: 'Hookworm anaemia = Ancylostoma duodenale (chamdi se ghus jata hai)'.

qe: A 'pseudocoelom' (false body cavity) is present in which animal phylum?
qh: 'छद्म गुहा' (pseudocoelom - झूठी शरीर-गुहा) किस संघ में पाई जाती है?
e: Concept: Body cavity ke teen level hote hain - acoelomate (bilkul guha nahi), pseudocoelomate (guha hai par mesoderm naam ki beech wali parat se poori tarah giri hui nahi) aur coelomate (sachchi guha, mesoderm se giri hui). Nematoda/Aschelminthes pseudocoelomate hain; iske vipreet Platyhelminthes acoelomate aur Annelida se aage wale saare coelomate hain. Baaki teen me pseudocoelom nahi: Platyhelminthes (acoelomate), Annelida aur Echinodermata (sachche coelomate). Exam point: 'Pseudocoelom = Aschelminthes/Nematoda'.

qe: Metameric segmentation (body divided into a series of ring-like segments) is the defining feature of:
qh: खंडित शरीर (मेटामेरिक सेगमेंटेशन - शरीर कई छल्लों जैसे खंडों में बँटा होना) किसकी पहचान है?
e: Concept: Metameric segmentation matlab sharir ke aage-peeche ki taraf ek jaisi chhalle (segments) hona, aur har segment me haar, nadi, nerve aur excretory organ ki apni copy ho. Ye feature Annelida se shuru hokar Arthropoda aur Chordata me bhi 'modify' roop me milta hai (jaise insaan ki vertebae). Baaki teen me aisa segment-wise repetition nahi: Nematoda (gol, ek jaisa), Mollusca (soft body+mantle), Echinodermata (spiny, radial). Exam point: 'Metameric segmentation = Annelida (earthworm, leech) ki khaas pehchaan'.

qe: Which of the following is an annelid (segmented worm)?
qh: इनमें से कौन एनीलिड (खंडित कृमि) है?
e: Concept: Annelida ke jeev 'segmented worms' hain - unka sharir lambe chhalle jaise hisson me bata hota hai, sharir ke andar ek sachchi coelom hoti hai, aur bahar ek patli kaik (cuticle) hoti hai. Inme Earthworm (khechua), Leech (joonk), Nereis (samudri kirmi) aate hain. Baaki teen alag groups ke: Tapeworm (Platyhelminthes), Hookworm (Nematoda), Cuttlefish (Mollusca). Exam point: 'Annelida = khechua, joonk, Nereis (sharir chhalle/segments me bata hua)'.

qe: The excretory organs of earthworm (an annelid) are:
qh: केंचुए (एनीलिड) के उत्सर्जन अंग हैं:
e: Concept: Nephridia chhote-khokhle coiled (ghumavdar) nali ke roop me har segment me hote hain; ye khoon/coelomic fluid se waste (urea, ammonia) chhan kar bahar nikalte hain - inhe 'kankhajure ki kidney' samajh lo. Baaki teen doosre jeevon ke organs hain: Flame cells (Platyhelminthes me), Malpighian tubules (keet/Arthropoda me), Gills (saans lene ke liye, excretion ke liye nahi). Exam point: 'Annelida ka excretory organ = Nephridia; flatworm = flame cells; insect = Malpighian tubules'.

qe: A chitinous exoskeleton, jointed appendages and compound eyes are characteristic of which phylum?
qh: काइटिन का बहिःकंकाल, जुड़े हुए पैर (jointed appendages) और संयुक्त नेत्र (compound eyes) किस संघ की विशेषता हैं?
e: Concept: Arthropoda (sabse bada phylum) ke jeevon ka bahari khaancha chitin naam ke kathor padarth ka banta hai (exoskeleton - bahari haddi), unke pair jodon (joints) wale hote hain, aur aankhen kai chhote lenson wali (compound eyes) hoti hain - isliye ye itne kamyab hain. Baaki teen me ye combo nahi: Mollusca (soft body + shell, radula), Annelida (segments, setae), Echinodermata (spiny skeleton, tube feet). Exam point: 'Chitin exoskeleton + jointed legs + compound eyes = Arthropoda'.

qe: Which of the following is NOT an insect?
qh: इनमें से कौन कीट (insect) नहीं है?
e: Concept: Insect ki pehchan: sharir 3 hisson me (sar, chest, pet), 6 pair (3 jodi), aur aksar 2 jodi pankh. Makdi (spider) ke 8 pair (4 jodi) lagte hain, 2 hisse hote hain, pankh nahi hoti aur makdi jala banati hai - isliye wo Arachnida (arachnid) hai, insect nahi. Housefly, Mosquito aur Honeybee saare sachche insects hain (6 legs). Insect ki chhaati (thorax) se hi 3 jodi legs jurte hain; makdi ke 8 legs aur 2 hisse hote hain isliye wo Arachnida me hai. Keet duniya ka sabse bada jeev-samuh hain (lagbhag 10 lakh se zyada species), isi liye entomology itna bada vishay hai. Exam point: 'Insect = 3 pair (6) legs; makdi/arachnid = 4 pair (8) legs'.

qe: How many pairs of legs do spiders and scorpions (Arachnida) have?
qh: मकड़ी और बिच्छू (एरेक्निडा) के कितने जोड़े पैर होते हैं?
e: Concept: Arachnida group (makdi, bichchhu, tick) ke jeevon ke 8 legs (4 jodi) hote hain - insects ke 6 (3 jodi) se alag; iske alawa unme pankh nahi hoti, sar aur chest jud kar 'cephalothorax' banta hai, aur unme khaas 'book lungs' hote hain. Ye '8 pairs' hi is group ko keeton (insects) se alag karta hai. Baaki teen numbers doosre groups ke hain: 6 (insects), 10 (kekda/prawn/crustaceans), 4 (kabhi nahi). Exam point: 'Arachnida (makdi/bichchhu) = 8 legs (4 jodi)'.

qe: Prawn, crab and lobster belong to which phylum?
qh: झींगा, केकड़ा और लॉबस्टर किस संघ के हैं?
e: Concept: Prawn, crab, lobster 'Crustacea' group ke arthropods hain - inka bahari coat chitin ka hota hai, pair jodon wale aur aankhen compound hoti hain; paani me rehne wale arthropods me ye sabse aam hain (unke saans ke liye gills hote hain). Baaki teen phylum ke animal alag hain: Mollusca (squid, octopus, snail), Annelida (khechua, joonk), Echinodermata (tara machhli). Exam point: 'Prawn/crab/lobster = Arthropoda (Crustacea)'.

qe: Soft-bodied animals having a mantle and usually a calcareous shell belong to which phylum?
qh: नर्म शरीर वाले, मेंटल (mantle - विशेष आवरण) और आमतौर पर कैल्शियम-युक्त खोल (shell) रखने वाले जंतु किस संघ के हैं?
e: Concept: Mollusca (ghongha, sip, squid, octopus) ke sharir ke andar naram 'visceral mass' hota hai aur usko ek khaas mahatvapurn parat 'mantle' dhakta hai; bahar aam taur par chuna (calcium carbonate) ka shell hota hai. Mantle ke andar ki jagah me khaas 'mantle cavity' hoti hai jisme gills hote hain, aur khaane ke liye unke munh me 'radula' (khurachne wali ribbon) hoti hai. Baaki teen phylum me ye dhaancha nahi. Exam point: 'Soft body + mantle + calcareous shell = Mollusca'.

qe: Which of the following is a mollusc?
qh: इनमें से कौन मोलस्क (Mollusca) है?
e: Concept: Squid (lambu, samudri jeev jise 'calamari' kehte hain) ek cephalopod mollusc hai - iska shell andar (astra) ke roop me hota hai, iske 8-10 arms/tentacles hote hain, aur iske khoon me copper wala pigment hemocyanin hota hai. Baaki teen ke naam me 'fish' hai par ye Mollusca nahi hain: Starfish (Echinodermata), Silverfish (ek keet/Arthropoda), Jellyfish (Coelenterata). Exam point: 'Squid/octopus/snail = Mollusca; starfish = Echinodermata; jellyfish = Coelenterata'.

qe: The 'water vascular system' (a network of water-filled canals used for movement) is the unique feature of which phylum?
qh: 'जल-संवहन तंत्र' (पानी से भरी नलियों का जाल जिससे गति होती है) किस संघ की अनोखी विशेषता है?
e: Concept: Echinodermata (tara machhli, samudri kheera) me ek khaas system hota hai jisme samudri paani naliyon me bhara rehta hai; ye paani 'tube feet' (bahut chhote chusni jais e paanv) tak jaata hai aur unke sikudne-failne se jeev chalta aur khana pakadta hai - isi ko water vascular system kehte hain. Baaki teen phylum me ye nahi hai (Mollusca me mantle+radula, Arthropoda me chitin, Annelida me nephridia). Exam point: 'Water vascular system + tube feet = Echinodermata'.

qe: The tube feet of echinoderms (like starfish) are mainly used for:
qh: एकाइनोडर्म (जैसे स्टारफिश) के ट्यूब फीट मुख्यतः किस काम आते हैं?
e: Concept: Tube feet chhote chusni jais e paanv hote hain jinke andar paani (water vascular system se) bharta-nikalta hai; inke sikudne se starfish dheere-dheere chalta hai, samudri tal par chipakta hai aur bivalve (sip) ko kheench kar kholta hai - yani movement aur khana pakadne ke liye. Inhi ke through gas exchange (saans lena) bhi thoda hota hai. Baaki teen kaam ye nahi karte (sunna, khoon jamna, roshni). Exam point: 'Tube feet = chalna, chipakna, khana pakadna (Echinodermata)'.

qe: Which of the following animals is an echinoderm?
qh: इनमें से कौन एकाइनोडर्म है?
e: Concept: Echinoderm ka matlab hai 'kant wali chamdi' - inke sharir me chuna (calcium carbonate) ke chhote-kathor plate/spines hote hain aur radial symmetry (gol/ghera wali sanrachana) hoti hai; is group me Starfish, Sea urchin, Sea cucumber (samudri kheera), Brittle star aate hain - sab samudri jeev hain. Baaki teen ke naam me 'fish' hai par ye echinoderm nahi: Cuttlefish (Mollusca), Silverfish (keet), Crayfish (Arthropoda/crustacean). Exam point: 'Sea cucumber/starfish/sea urchin = Echinodermata'.

qe: Which animal phylum is exclusively marine (all its members live only in the sea)?
qh: कौन-सा जंतु संघ पूरी तरह समुद्री है (इसके सभी सदस्य केवल समुद्र में रहते हैं)?
e: Concept: Echinodermata ka har sadasya samudri hai - taza paani ya zameen par inka koi jeev nahi milta (Starfish, sea urchin, sea cucumber, brittle star, sea lily). Iske vipreet baaki bade phylum me mithas paani aur zameen dono ke jeev milte hain: Annelida (khechua zameen par, leech), Mollusca (snail zameen par bhi), Arthropoda (keet, makdi zameen par). Echinoderm naam ka matlab hai 'kantewali chamdi' (echinos = kante, derma = chamdi) - starfish ki satah par chhote kante (spines) hote hain. Inke sharir me 'water vascular system' hoti hai jisse wo chalte hain aur khana pakadte hain. Exam point: 'Exclusively marine phylum = Echinodermata'.

qe: Notochord, dorsal hollow nerve cord, pharyngeal gill slits and post-anal tail are the four fundamental characters of which phylum?
qh: नोटोकॉर्ड, पृष्ठीय खोखली तंत्रिका रज्जु, ग्रसनीय क्लोम-छिद्र और गुदा के बाद पूँछ - ये चार मूल लक्षण किस संघ के हैं?
e: Concept: Chordata phylum ke jeev ki khaas pehchaan char lakshan hain: (1) notochord - ek lachakdar dand (jo kai me backbone me badal jata hai), (2) dorsal hollow nerve cord - peeth ki taraf khokhli nerve rassi (spinal cord), (3) pharyngeal gill slits - gale me khaan (machhli me gills, zameen ke jeevon me kaan/nas ki naliyon se juda hissa), (4) post-anal tail - sharir ke peeche poonch. In chaaron ka zindagi ke kisi na kisi daur me hona hi Chordata hai. Baaki teen phylum me ye nahi hote. Exam point: '4 fundamental characters = Chordata'.

qe: The acorn worm Balanoglossus belongs to which phylum?
qh: एकॉर्न वर्म बैलेनोग्लॉसस किस संघ का है?
e: Concept: Balanoglossus ek samudri keeda hai jisme aadhe chordate jaise lakshan (notochord jaisa hissa) hote hain par poori tarah Chordata nahi hai; isliye ise alag phylum Hemichordata me rakha jata hai - yani ye Chordata ka 'rishtedaar' hai. Ye is baat ka example hai ki classification me ek jaisa dikhne wala jeev bhi apne alag group me daala jata hai. Baaki teen phylum bilkul alag hain: Chordata (notochord wale), Annelida (khechua), Mollusca (ghongha). Exam point: 'Balanoglossus = Hemichordata (Chordata ka kareebi rishtedaar)'.

qe: Amphioxus (Branchiostoma), a small fish-like animal that has a notochord but no vertebral column, is classified as:
qh: एम्फीऑक्सस (ब्रांकियोस्टोमा), एक छोटा मछली जैसा जीव जिसमें नोटोकॉर्ड है पर कशेरुक-मेरुदंड नहीं, किस श्रेणी में आता है?
e: Concept: Protochordata (prathmik chordate) unhe kehte hain jinke paas notochord (peeth ka dand) hota hai par uske around haddi ka merudand (vertebral column) nahi banta - jaise Amphioxus (Branchiostoma) aur Ascidia. Ye Chordata ka saral/wadhit roop hai aur samudra me rehta hai; yahi se evolution me aage backbone wale Vertebrata bane. Baaki teen incorrect: cartilage wali machhli (shark) aur mollusc/annelid alag phylum hain. Exam point: 'Amphioxus = protochordate (notochord hai, back-haddi nahi)'.

qe: Which of the following is a vertebrate (animal with a backbone)?
qh: इनमें से कौन कशेरुकी (vertebrate - मेरुदंड/backbone वाला) है?
e: Concept: Vertebrata (kasheruk) wo chordates hain jinke sharir me notochord ki jagah asli haddi ka merudand (vertebral column/backbone) ban jata hai aur jisme brain ko gherene wali khopdi hoti hai. Frog (mendhak) ek vertebrate hai (Amphibia class). Baaki teen invertebrate hain: Earthworm (Annelida), Starfish (Echinodermata), Prawn (Arthropoda) - inke paas asli backbone nahi hota. Exam point: 'Vertebrate = backbone wale jeev (machhli, mendhak, sarisrip, pakshi, stanpaayi)'.

qe: Which animal group shows radial symmetry in the adult stage?
qh: कौन-सा जंतु समूह वयस्क अवस्था में अरीय सममिति (radial symmetry) दिखाता है?
e: Concept: Symmetry do tarah ki hoti hai - bilateral (dono taraf ek jaisa, jaise insaan/earthworm/snake/frog - sar aur poonch alag) aur radial (beech ke bindu ke aas-paas gol, jaise pahiya - upar-neeche sab ek jaisa, jaise jellyfish aur starfish). Echinoderme (starfish) adult me radial (paanch-tarfa) dikhte hain, par unka larva bilateral hota hai - isliye wo 'special' case hain. Baaki teen bilateral hain (Earthworm, Snake, Frog). Exam point: 'Adult radial symmetry = starfish/jellyfish (echinoderm/cnidarian); baaki zyadatar jeev bilateral'.
